purpose: Record authoritative authorization assets that exist today and distinguish them from feature-bound canonical mappings.

AUTHZ-001.reason: Role/permission catalogs exist; Feature→API→Entity→enforcement binding is not evidence-bound.

AUTHZ-002.reason: Permission catalog and authorization rules exist; Feature-specific API enforcement binding is not established.

AUTHZ-003.reason: Entitlement-related permissions/layer resolution exist; canonical entitlement persistence/entity binding is not established.

AUTHZ-004.reason: Subscription/entitlement authority concepts exist; Feature-specific derived-access mapping is not established.

AUTHZ-005.reason: Resource ownership is a canonical authorization dimension; no Feature-bound entity/API/ownership enforcement evidence is established.

AUTHZ-006.reason: Organization-scoped permissions exist; Feature-specific organization/team entity and API mapping remains open.

AUTHZ-007.reason: OAuth/API scope is named as a capability, but no canonical operation/DTO/security binding is established.

AUTHZ-008.reason: Temporary/delegated ordering is defined conceptually; no feature-bound lifecycle/persistence mapping is established.

AUTHZ-009.reason: Service-account/API-key capability is inventoried; canonical entity/persistence/security mapping is not established.

AUTHZ-010.reason: Audit permission and auditability rules exist; Feature-bound audit event/storage mapping is not established.

ORG-001.reason: org.create and organization membership permission concepts exist, but organization entity/API binding is not established.

ORG-002.reason: MCN is inventoried but no canonical MCN entity/field/creator-binding contract is established.

ORG-003.reason: Organization member/role permissions exist, but team/member entity and lifecycle mapping is not established.

ORG-004.reason: Identity/organization separation is authoritative, but creator-binding entity/lifecycle mapping is not established.

ORG-005.reason: Authorization catalog exists, but creator contract/revenue-split data authority and financial mapping are not established.

ORG-007.reason: Organization management permissions/lifecycle principles exist, but approval/audit/transfer mapping is not established.
